verdict.rationale: Gaming performance is a fair question for a GPU, so the axis applies. However, the evidence offers no vendor 4K high-refresh gaming claims and no independent game benchmarks. DisplayPort 2.1 output (8K 240Hz), DLSS 4 for photorealistic rendering, and tools for game developers are adjacent features, not evidence that the card plays games at high frame rates. The community items cover AI builds, hardware defects and pricing, none of which concern gaming performance.

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks
